	//getFields will return a comma separated list of fields stored in the appProfile object
	appProfile.getFields = function() {
		var fieldsList;
		for(var x in appProfile) {
			if(typeof this[x] != 'function') {
				if(fieldsList == undefined) { 
					fieldsList = x; 
				} else { 
					fieldsList += ", "+x;
				}
			}
		}
		return fieldsList;
	} // getFields
	//get will return the object stored for the passed FieldName
	appProfile.get = function(strFieldName) {
		strFieldName = (typeof strFieldName == 'undefined') ? this.ProfileName : strFieldName;	
		return this[strFieldName];
	} // get

TN 18 (09-24)

   
RS 01803.002 
How to Compute NESE
   

   
   
   

      

         
PROCEDURE
         

      

      

         

            

               
1. 
Gross Income
               

            

            

               
Add the gross earnings from all trades or businesses carried on by the self-employed
                  person, to compute net earnings.
               

            

         

         

            

               
2. 
Partnership Income
               

            

            

               
Include their distributive share of income from a partnership of which they are a
                  general partner.
               

            

         

         

            

               
3. 
Exclusion
               

            

            

               
Exclude any types of income so specified by the Act or the Internal Revenue Code (IRC).

            

         

         

            

               
4. 
Business Expenses
               

            

            

               
Subtract any ordinary and necessary expenses incurred in carrying on the business.

            

         

         

            

               
5. 
Tax Deduction
               

            

            

               
Multiply the result by .9235 (i.e., 100% - 7.65% = 92.35% or 0.9235) to derive the
                  NESE, beginning with taxable years after 12/31/89.
